---
title: "shinyNTApro Analysis Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  application_version: "Unknown"
  active_filters: !r NULL
  assignment_map: !r NULL
  comparison_plot1: !r NULL
  comparison_plot2: !r NULL
  main_data: !r NULL
  metadata: !r NULL
  qc_status: !r NULL
  group_assignments_file: "None"
  stat_test_results_object: !r NULL
  stat_plot_object: !r NULL
  precision_results: !r NULL
  selected_id_col: !r NULL
  selected_stat_metric: !r NULL
  report_run_time: !r Sys.time()
  input_file_name: "N/A"
  distribution_data_for_report: !r NULL
  dist_plot_object_for_report: !r NULL
  distribution_plot_height: 6
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  results = "asis",
  comment = NA,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 150
)

is_nonempty_df <- function(x) {
  is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) > 0
}

print_table <- function(x, caption = NULL, digits = 4) {
  if (!is_nonempty_df(x)) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat("\n\n<div class=\"report-table\">\n", as.character(knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, digits = digits, format = "html", escape = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)), "\n</div>\n\n", sep = "")
}

safe_value <- function(x, fallback = "N/A") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) fallback else x
}
```

<style>
.report-table { overflow-x: auto; margin: 16px 0 24px; }
.report-table table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }
.report-table th, .report-table td { padding: 8px 12px; min-width: 100px; max-width: 280px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px solid #e1e6eb; }
.report-table th { background: #edf3f6; }
.report-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f8fafb; }
</style>

# Analysis information

```{r analysis-information}
run_info <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Report generated", "Input file(s)", "Selected identifier", "Group assignment file", "Selected statistical metric"),
  Value = c(
    format(params$report_run_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
    safe_value(params$input_file_name),
    safe_value(params$selected_id_col),
    safe_value(params$group_assignments_file, "None"),
    safe_value(params$selected_stat_metric)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print_table(run_info)
```

# Analysis scope and group assignments

```{r analysis-scope}
cat("Application version: ", params$application_version, "\n\n", sep = "")
if (length(params$active_filters)) {
  filters <- data.frame(Filter = names(params$active_filters), Selection = vapply(params$active_filters,
    function(x) if (length(x)) paste(x, collapse = ", ") else "All", character(1)))
  print_table(filters)
}
if (is_nonempty_df(params$assignment_map)) {
  mapping <- params$assignment_map
  print_table(data.frame(Imported = nrow(mapping), Included_by_filters = sum(mapping$included_by_filters),
    Excluded_by_filters = sum(!mapping$included_by_filters), Assigned = sum(!is.na(mapping$group)),
    Included_in_statistics = sum(mapping$included_in_statistics)))
  cat("\nComplete sample-to-group mapping. Statistical inclusion refers to the selected parameter and design; review the statistical results for diagnostic restrictions.\n\n")
  print_table(mapping)
}
```

# Comparison plots

```{r comparison-plots}
if (!is.null(params$comparison_plot1)) print(params$comparison_plot1)
if (!is.null(params$comparison_plot2)) print(params$comparison_plot2)
```

# File metadata

```{r metadata}
if (is_nonempty_df(params$metadata)) {
  print_table(params$metadata)
} else {
  cat("No file metadata were available.\n")
}
```

# Parsed summary data

```{r data-summary}
if (is_nonempty_df(params$main_data)) {
  numeric_columns <- names(params$main_data)[vapply(params$main_data, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  data_summary <- data.frame(
    Records = nrow(params$main_data),
    Variables = ncol(params$main_data),
    Numeric_variables = length(numeric_columns),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print_table(data_summary)

  preview_columns <- intersect(
    c("source_file", "sample_name", "well_id", "group", numeric_columns),
    names(params$main_data)
  )
  preview_columns <- unique(preview_columns)[seq_len(min(length(unique(preview_columns)), 12))]
  if (length(preview_columns)) {
    cat("\n## Data preview\n\n")
    print_table(utils::head(params$main_data[, preview_columns, drop = FALSE], 20))
  }
} else {
  cat("No parsed summary data were available.\n")
}
```

# Quality-control result

```{r qc-result}
qc <- params$qc_status
if (is.null(qc)) {
  cat("No QC summary file was analysed for this report.\n")
} else if (!is.null(qc$message) && identical(qc$status, "ERROR")) {
  cat("**QC error:** ", qc$message, "\n", sep = "")
} else {
  qc_table <- data.frame(
    Item = c("Overall status", "Source file", "Target size (nm)", "Tolerance (%)", "Lower bound (nm)", "Upper bound (nm)"),
    Value = c(
      safe_value(qc$status),
      safe_value(qc$source_file),
      safe_value(qc$target),
      safe_value(qc$tolerance),
      safe_value(qc$lower_bound),
      safe_value(qc$upper_bound)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print_table(qc_table)

  if (is_nonempty_df(qc$results)) {
    cat("\n## QC wells\n\n")
    print_table(qc$results)
  }
}
```

# Statistical comparison

```{r statistical-results}
stats_result <- params$stat_test_results_object
if (is.null(stats_result)) {
  cat("No grouped statistical analysis was available.\n")
} else if (!is.null(stats_result$error)) {
  cat("**Statistical analysis error:** ", stats_result$error, "\n", sep = "")
  print_table(stats_result$assumptions$normality_by_group, caption = "Within-group normality diagnostics")
} else {
  stats_overview <- data.frame(
    Item = c("Study design", "Executed test", safe_value(stats_result$selection_heading, "Selection rationale"), "Smallest available within-group Shapiro p", "Median-centred Levene variance p"),
    Value = c(
      safe_value(stats_result$study_design),
      safe_value(stats_result$test_label, stats_result$test_name),
      safe_value(stats_result$selection_reason),
      safe_value(stats_result$assumptions$shapiro_p),
      safe_value(stats_result$assumptions$levene_p)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print_table(stats_overview)
  print_table(stats_result$assumptions$normality_by_group, caption = "Within-group normality diagnostics")
  cat("\n", safe_value(stats_result$inference_note, ""), "\n")

  if (!is.null(stats_result$main_result_print)) {
    cat("\n**Main result:** ", stats_result$main_result_print, "\n", sep = "")
  }

  if (is_nonempty_df(stats_result$main_result)) {
    cat("\n## Main test table\n\n")
    print_table(stats_result$main_result)
  }

  cat("\n## Effect sizes\n\n")
  if (is_nonempty_df(stats_result$effect_size)) {
    print_table(stats_result$effect_size)
  } else cat("Effect-size estimate not available for this analysis.\n")

  if (is_nonempty_df(stats_result$post_hoc_result)) {
    cat(if (stats_result$test_name %in% c("t.test", "wilcox.test")) "\n## Two-group comparison (unadjusted p-value)\n\n" else "\n## Post-hoc comparisons\n\n")
    cat("Method: ", safe_value(stats_result$post_hoc_method), "\n\n", sep = "")
    print_table(stats_result$post_hoc_result)
  } else if (is.character(stats_result$post_hoc_result)) {
    cat("\n", stats_result$post_hoc_result, "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```

```{r statistical-plot, fig.cap="Statistical group comparison"}
if (!is.null(params$stat_plot_object)) {
  print(params$stat_plot_object)
}
```

# QC history and precision

```{r precision-summary}
precision <- params$precision_results
if (is.null(precision)) {
  cat("No longitudinal QC precision analysis was available.\n")
} else {
  precision_table <- data.frame(
    Item = c(
      "Metric", "QC records", "Measurement days", "Overall mean", "Overall SD",
      "Mean of daily means", "Between-day SD", "Inter-day CV (%)", "Inter-day limit (%)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      safe_value(precision$metric_selected),
      safe_value(precision$n_total_points),
      safe_value(precision$n_days),
      safe_value(precision$overall_mean),
      safe_value(precision$overall_sd),
      safe_value(precision$mean_of_daily_means),
      safe_value(precision$sd_between_days),
      safe_value(precision$cv_inter),
      safe_value(precision$inter_day_limit)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print_table(precision_table)

  if (is_nonempty_df(precision$daily_stats)) {
    cat("\n## Daily precision summary\n\n")
    print_table(precision$daily_stats)
  }
}
```

# Particle-size distributions

```{r distribution-summary}
distribution_data <- params$distribution_data_for_report
if (is_nonempty_df(distribution_data)) {
  sample_column <- intersect(c("series_key", "sample_key", "SampleName_dist", "sample_name_dist"), names(distribution_data))[1]
  curve_count <- if (!is.na(sample_column)) length(unique(distribution_data[[sample_column]])) else NA_integer_
  distribution_summary <- data.frame(
    Distribution_records = nrow(distribution_data),
    Curves = curve_count,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print_table(distribution_summary)
} else {
  cat("No particle-size distribution data were available.\n")
}
```

```{r distribution-plot, fig.cap="Particle-size distribution", fig.height=params$distribution_plot_height}
if (!is.null(params$dist_plot_object_for_report)) {
  print(params$dist_plot_object_for_report)
}
```
